title: Redis cache crashes repeatedly
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies cache as broken part, crash as problem, and API 2.3.2 Lua script as trigger.
root_cause: The recent deployment of API version 2.3.2 introduced a Lua script that triggers a segmentation fault in Redis 7.4's Lua engine, causing the cache container to crash repeatedly.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a new Lua script for atomic cart updates that triggers a segmentation fault in Redis 7.4, causing the cache to crash and restart every few minutes under load.
